title: Dynamics, Momentum and Power
main_stem: A block is pulled by a force $X$ in a straight line along a rough horizontal surface, as shown in Fig. 3.1. Assume that the total resistive force opposing the motion of the block is $0.80\,\text{N}$ at all speeds of the block. The variation with time $t$ of the magnitude of the force $X$ is shown in Fig. 3.2.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the change in momentum of the block from time $t = 0$ to time $t = 3.0\,\text{s}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Describe and explain the motion of the block between time $t = 3.0\,\text{s}$ and time $t = 6.0\,\text{s}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Force $X$ produces a total power of $2.0\,\text{W}$ when moving the block between time $t = 3.0\,\text{s}$ and time $t = 6.0\,\text{s}$. Calculate the distance moved by the block during this time interval.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: The block is at rest at time $t = 0$. On Fig. 3.3, sketch a graph to show the variation of the momentum of the block with time $t$ from $t = 0$ to $t = 6.0\,\text{s}$. Numerical values of momentum are not required.
